messages:
Aisha M.: quick note from a tiny bring-up: tested nova14b-int6 on our doc-summarization slice (~5k queries). posting distilled numbers + proposal.

Rafael T.: drop numbers pls

Aisha M.: ```
model: nova14b-int6
slice: docsum_prod_sample (~5k)
avg tokens: 220
latency p95: 280ms
latency p99: 920ms
qps single shard: 12
cost / 1M tokens: $9.6
baseline (nova14b-int8) cost / 1M: $13.5 (~29% down)
quality vs int8:
  - Rouge-L: 44.0 -> 43.1 (-0.9)
  - Answer F1: 78.5 -> 76.6 (-1.9)
  - factual-error-rate heuristic: 2.8% -> 4.4% (+1.6pp)
notes: longer context summaries show more factual drift; short docs OK.
```

Priya S.: product translation: ~1.8pt F1 drop ~= ~1% helpfulness on doc flows. could matter for enterprise contracts.

Evan G.: infra: p99 920ms is high. mixed routing + cache likely needed. also consider calibrating quant table with a focused factuality calibration set.

Aisha M.: rollout suggestion:
- Canary: 15% for 10 days with event-level halluc markers.
- Mixed routing: route>200-token requests to int8; short requests to int6.
- Auto-fallback rule: if factual-error-rate +1.2pp sustained 72h -> rollback.

deploy-bot: Scheduled canary: nova14b-int6 -> docsum route 15% starting 2025-06-03T14:00:00Z (owner: Aisha M.).

Priya S.: action items: Aisha push eval configs + halluc markers; Rafael set routing rules and short-request mapping; Evan run quant calibration sweep. aiming signoff tomorrow. :thumbsup:
